description: "The Prison Chaplaincy, And Its Experiences" by Hosea Quinby is a historical account written in the late 19th century. This work details the author's firsthand experiences as the chaplain of the New Hampshire State Prison, focusing on his efforts for reforming inmates through spiritual guidance and educational initiatives.
